description: MFJ, $340,500 wages of which $20,000 qualified overtime premium. Mirrors the IRS Schedule 1-A worked example: MAGI $40,500 over $300k -> floor(40.5)=40 steps -> $4,000 reduction -> $16,000 deduction. Taxable 340,500-31,500-16,000=293,000 -> tax $56,014.00. Includes Additional Medicare Tax 0.9% x $90,500 = $814.50. [Form 8959 Part I whole-dollar: 0.9% x 90,500 = 814.50 -> $815.]
